description: Return the (minimum, maximum) of a list of numbers as a tuple, guarding against the empty list. Pure and deterministic; the floor calls the built-in min and max once each (a duplicated rewrite would re-derive each extreme with its own hand-rolled scan, repeating the same loop logic twice). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: a multi-element list, a single element (min equals max), negatives, an all-equal list, and a sorted list. The empty-list ValueError is exercised by the pytest gate in test_suite.py, since the golden recorder captures return values, not exceptions. The reference returns a tuple; the golden recorder normalizes it to a two-element list via the JSON round-trip.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
